world.name: The Fractured Causeway
world.blurb: The Fractured Causeway: one continuous road with 13 checkpointed challenges, ending in a superroom.
world.outro: Three counterweights lie across three silent courts. The Iron Echo has stopped trying. The wind beyond the causeway blows uphill.

keepsake.name: Silas, remembered
keepsake.gives: His first freely chosen step outlasted the machine that counted the others. Shown at the end.

rooms.name: Chainwake, After the Bell
rooms.hint: Jump as the lift slams to a stop and it throws you · a down-diagonal dash that lands keeps going (an ultra) · jump out of it over the pit
rooms.question: The lift throws you straight at the roof, and the sill under it is cracked. How do you get under it without losing the speed?

rooms.name: The Drop Yard
rooms.hint: Land the down-diagonal dash and it keeps going along the floor (an ultra) · jump out of it and it is a hyper · catch the far wall and climb to the door
rooms.question: The sill under the roof is cracked and the yard beyond is wide. What do you land with, and what do you leave with?

rooms.name: The Relay Gantry
rooms.hint: Dash into a tear while the lift’s throw still carries you · it sets you down on a cracked perch · onto the next lift, and jump off it over the brake thorns
rooms.question: The tear’s mouth is in the air. When is it in reach, and how long does the perch it sets you on hold?

rooms.name: The Forty-First Pace
rooms.hint: Silas’s winding key opens the abandoned maintenance shaft · the road: a throw, a dive, a hyper, a dive under the brake housing
rooms.question: Will you follow the step beyond his old turning point?

people.name: SILAS’S ECHO
people.line: Forty paces. I remember the forty-first better.
people.lineDone: I chose that step. That part still belongs to me.

rooms.name: The Counterpoise
rooms.hint: Throw, dive under the bar, hyper · dash into the tear in flight · two hypers under the brake, cracked shelf to cracked shelf
rooms.question: The same causeway, the other way, and the brake roof over the top. Where does each hyper start?

rooms.name: The Broken Chainwalk
rooms.hint: Cracked links under the brake roof: hyper link to link · dash into the tear in flight · it sets you on a cracked perch: back along the high walk
rooms.question: Out along the low walk, up the tear, back along the high walk, and no link that holds. Where does each hyper start?

rooms.name: The Last Gantry
rooms.hint: Throw, dive, hyper · dash into the tear in flight · the lip it sets you on is cracked: super off it before it falls
rooms.question: Eight moves and nowhere to stand between them. Which one do you rehearse first?

rooms.name: The Broken Standard
rooms.hint: The Iron Echo can break what your blade cannot · every charge ends in a stamp along the floor
rooms.question: Where will its committed charge end, and where will you be when the floor shakes?

rooms.name: The West Counterweight
rooms.hint: Two weights, two crushes · after the first it gets up faster, and every charge ends in a stamp
rooms.question: The first weight only cracks it. Where must the armour stop before the second falls?

rooms.name: The East Counterweight
rooms.hint: The second court runs the other way · two weights again, and it is quicker after the first
rooms.question: Can you put the weight between its charge and the floor twice?

rooms.name: The Quiet Maintenance Shaft
rooms.hint: The lift’s throw, a dive onto the cracked sill and a hyper out · dash into the tear in flight · two hypers under the brake, cracked sill to cracked sill · up and out
rooms.question: Eleven moves, and every sill in the shaft is cracked. Where does each one start?

rooms.name: A Gear That No Longer Turns
rooms.hint: Throw, dive under the bar, hyper · the tear carries you once, to the far corner · super off its cracked lip · the crystal pays back a dash · two more cracked shelves
rooms.question: The gear sits at the far end of the top of the room, three cracked shelves away. How many dashes is that, and which one does the crystal pay for?

people.name: SILAS’S ECHO
people.line: There was a bench beyond the turning point. I never knew.
people.lineDone: I sat there because I wanted to.

rooms.name: Pogo Up
rooms.question: The roof is thorns and the pods hang just under it. Which way do you cut to bounce off them?

rooms.name: Let the Train Go Low
rooms.hint: Send the train low. Cut the mirror during your feather flight, before its shutter opens.
rooms.question: Which branch should the train take when its rider can choose a different flight?

rooms.name: Shorten the Arc
rooms.hint: Hold grab to hang. Up shortens the chain; down pays it out. The moving thorns keep their routes.
rooms.question: Where can you remain on the chain while the dangerous part of its arc is occupied?

rooms.name: His Charge Opens Your Return
rooms.hint: Two falling weights only crack him. Return behind the first weight: it can finish its journey sideways.
rooms.question: How can the weight you dropped first become both your final weapon and your return launch?

rooms.name: The Line Behind the Brittle Wall
rooms.question: The first wall freed a line. What must the same brute open next?
rooms.hint: Use the roof above the right wall to draw the first charge. Drop into the small pocket on its left to send the brute away before entering the alcove. Ride to the enclosed sight perch; its thorn grating lets the brute see you on the other side. Once it breaks the second wall, cross to the flag below the starting road. The one-way line above the flag returns you to the exit.

puzzleRoutes.name: Open the line, send the brute away, bait its second breach from the sight perch

rooms.name: The Weight You Must Take Back
rooms.question: Who keeps the launch loaded while you leave, and who must take over?
rooms.hint: Leave the lantern on the recoil plate while you work at the lower hub. With the plate held down, fold the arm through its right pose and down to open your return. Board the plate, hold down while taking the lantern back, then throw it clear to the left. Release into the stored rise and jump before dashing up-left to the high landing.

puzzleRoutes.name: Leave the weight, open the return, take over the load, and launch empty-handed

rooms.name: The Wall You Must Fold After Climbing
rooms.question: What must this wall become after you have climbed it?
rooms.hint: Climb the right side of the hanging arm to the service ledge. Fold it left from beside the upper pivot before taking the one-way line back. Land on the prepared arm, then use a down-left landing dash and wavedash beneath the canopy. Clear the canopy and dash up-left to the high landing.

rooms.name: The Bridge You Must Build Backwards
rooms.question: Which bridge must leave its useful position so the other can pass?
rooms.hint: Park the far bridge upright. Its service ledge stays put. Visit the low hub and turn the near arm through left and up to right. Ride back to the far hub and restore its left bridge. Cross beneath the upper roof to the return line, then wavedash from the completed lower runway and dash up-right after clearing the canopy.

rooms.name: The Cover You Must Take Away
rooms.question: What is keeping the brute from seeing the bait it needs to chase?
rooms.hint: Cross the covered bridge to its hub and strike downward to fold the cover away. The permanent perch keeps you above the charge. Let the brute open the left wall, descend on the right of the hanging arm, and jump past the recovering brute into the alcove. Its line delivers to the finishing runway: land a down-right dash, jump out with speed, then dash up-right beyond the canopy.

rooms.name: The Delivery You Cannot Ride With
rooms.question: Which route delivers the lantern, and which route delivers you?
rooms.hint: Take the lantern onto the throwing dock and send it right beneath the low guide. The chute carries it through the narrow opening to lower the distant runway. Return to the hub and fold the dock down to uncover the line chamber. Ride across empty-handed; leave the lantern working while you wavedash from the lowered runway and dash up-right beyond the overhang.

retiredRoomDetails.name: The Unlit Well
retiredRoomDetails.evidence: A descending solid staircase with no hazard glyph, enemy or device; the entire saved route is [200, left]. The hint explicitly calls it a breath before the courts. This is the clearest Fractured low-complexity slot, but keep some safe boss preparation rather than filling every breather.

retiredRoomDetails.name: The Counterweight Rise
retiredRoomDetails.evidence: One rising lift launches to a cracked lip and then a second cracked sill; the main demand is two supers in succession. The first lift/ultra route and Relay Gantry already teach lift momentum and unstable arrival, while Last Gantry is the fuller combination. Preserve vertical/horizontal seam orientation.

retiredRoomDetails.name: The Last Count
retiredRoomDetails.reason: Replaced by its native boss superroom
